D: A rough cop gets a convict out of prison for 48 hours to help catch a killer.
P: Pour drinks when Reggie announces the new sheriff in town.
S: Peanuts roasted in the shell with salt and cayenne
Peanuts in the shell roasted at 180C for 20 minutes, tossed hot with salt and cayenne, served in a tin bucket.
Reggie's last lunch on the inside

Bologna and American cheese on white bread with yellow mustard, griddled in butter under a heavy pan until golden, crisp and melted. Spread 8 slices white bread with yellow mustard on one side. Build 4 sandwiches with 3 slices bologna and 2 slices American cheese each. Butter the outsides. Cook in a pan over medium heat with another heavy pan pressed on top for 3 minutes a side until crisp and the cheese melts. Cut into triangles and serve with dill pickles.
Warm torn sourdough with whipped roasted garlic butter
Warm a sourdough round at 200C, tear and serve with salted butter whipped with roasted garlic.
M: Jack's 3am bacon, eggs and hash browns
Not partners, not brothers, not friends.

Thick bacon rendered crisp, eggs fried in the fat, golden hash browns of grated potato fried in butter, buttered toast and hot sauce. Grate 800g potatoes and squeeze out as much water as you can in a tea towel, then season. Fry in 40g butter and 2 tbsp oil in 4 flat patties for 6 minutes a side until deep golden. Fry 12 thick bacon rashers until crisp and keep warm. Fry 8 eggs in the bacon fat, basting the tops. Toast and butter 4 slices of bread and serve with hot sauce.
Seafood stew of crab, clams, mussels, prawns and fish in tomato and white wine
Fennel, onion and garlic in olive oil, tomato, white wine and fish stock, then crab, clams, mussels, prawns and firm fish in order of cooking time. Sourdough.
W: Six months left on Reggie's sentence.
One-bowl chocolate cake (flour, sugar, cocoa, oil, buttermilk, hot coffee) baked at 170C for 35 minutes, fudge icing.
K: Ice cold lager served with a shot of bourbon, bitters and orange peel

A shot of bourbon alongside an ice-cold long neck, with a dash of bitters and orange peel in the shot glass for good measure. Chill 4 long neck lagers until icy. Pour 30ml bourbon into each of 4 shot glasses, add a dash of aromatic bitters and twist a small strip of orange peel over each. Serve each shot with a cold beer. Sip the bourbon and chase it with the beer, or drop it in if it's that kind of night.

steps.text: Slice the fennel and onion, crush the garlic, cut the king oyster mushrooms into thick coins and the zucchini into chunks.
Sear the mushroom coins in 1 tbsp of the olive oil until golden on both sides, then set aside.
Soften the fennel, onion and garlic in the rest of the oil.
Add the tomatoes, white wine, vegetable stock and crumbled nori and simmer.
Add the zucchini and cannellini beans for 8 minutes, then return the mushrooms to warm through.
Serve with sliced sourdough.

s.note: Hot roasted peanuts with salt and cayenne
s.how: Spread 400g peanuts in the shell on a tray and roast at 180C for 20 minutes. Toss straight away with 1 tsp fine salt and a pinch of cayenne. Tip into a tin bucket and put an empty bowl out for the shells.

s.note: Warm torn sourdough with roasted garlic butter
s.how: Roast a garlic head wrapped in foil at 180C for 40 minutes. Squeeze into 125g soft salted butter and whip. Warm a sourdough round at 200C for 10 minutes, tear into chunks and serve with the butter.

m.note: Seafood stew of crab, clams, mussels and prawns in tomato
m.how: Soften 1 sliced fennel, 1 onion and 3 garlic cloves in oil. Add 1 tin tomatoes, 250ml white wine and 500ml fish stock, simmer 20 minutes. Add 1 crab, then 500g clams and mussels, then 300g prawns and 300g fish. Serve with sourdough.

w.note: One-bowl chocolate cake with thick fudge icing
w.how: Whisk 250g flour, 300g sugar, 60g cocoa and 1 tsp bicarb. Add 125ml oil, 250ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 250ml hot coffee. Bake at 170C for 35 minutes. Ice with 250g icing sugar, 40g cocoa, 60g soft butter and a splash of hot water.

d.note: A shot of bourbon alongside an ice-cold long neck, with a dash of bitters and orange peel in the shot glass for good measure.
d.how: Chill 4 long neck lagers until icy. Pour 30ml bourbon into each of 4 shot glasses, add a dash of aromatic bitters and twist a small strip of orange peel over each. Serve each shot with a cold beer. Sip the bourbon and chase it with the beer, or drop it in if it's that kind of night.
